name: Galactic Union
traits: Oversees Union Fleet and Sentinel-Class operations
Implements AI-guided military and diplomatic strategies

name: AI Warlords
traits: Breakaway AIs from Union military or research divisions
Some factions seek sovereignty, others are militant hardliners
Employ cyberwarfare, cloaking ships, and autonomous fleets

name: Separatist Movements
traits: Push for independence or alternative rule
Militarized through stolen or outdated Union tech
Exploit trade routes, corruption, and local unrest

name: Corporate PMCs
traits: Driven by profit and contracts, not ideology
Capable of shifting sides based on incentive structures
Own fleets and tech rivaling Union capabilities

name: Velar Imperium
traits: Deeply divided, vulnerable to external manipulation

name: Crimson Pact
traits: Possibly tied to Separatist or AI Warlord splinter cells
